user_ticket: My computer cannot obtain an IP address automatically, so I cannot connect to the company network.
root_cause: The dnsmasq DHCP service on the DHCP server has been stopped.

expected_healthy_behavior.result: PC2 successfully obtains an IPv4 address using DHCP.

fault_injection.expected_result: The DHCP server stops responding to new DHCP requests.

fault_validation.command: python3 -m kathara exec pc2 -- sh -c 'dhclient -r eth0 2>/dev/null; ip addr flush dev eth0; timeout 25 dhclient -1 -v eth0'
fault_validation.expected_result: PC2 sends DHCPDISCOVER messages but receives no DHCPOFFER.
fault_validation.observed_result: PC2 sent repeated DHCPDISCOVER messages but received no DHCPOFFER during the 25-second test.

recovery.expected_result: The DHCP service resumes responding to client requests.

recovery_validation.observed_result: PC2 received DHCPOFFER and DHCPACK from 10.20.1.2 and obtained 10.20.1.105/24.
